Lotad

Water Grass

Hoenn · Generation 3

Lotad is a Water/Grass-type Water Weed Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 2.6 kg. It evolves into Lombre. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (50), with a base stat total of 220.
